headline: Critical Java4Shell flaw enables remote code execution across Java apps
summary: A critical vulnerability called Java4Shell in OpenJDK can let unauthenticated attackers remotely execute code on major applications such as Jenkins, Jira, Confluence, and Keycloak, and can be triggered simply by inputting repeated text. Oracle has disclosed the bug as urgent, though one report attributes its discovery to an AI-driven startup that had previously found a PHP flaw. Millions of sites and services are described as at risk.
